title: Downtown Nashville • Walk to Broadway!
description:
This stunning apartment offers resort-style amenities that includes a heated pool, beautifully designed courtyard with grills and cozy fire pits, a top-floor sky lounge with incredible views, and a two-story fitness center featuring a rock climbing wall. Perfectly located just 1 block from Music City Center and the Hall of Fame, and it's only 2 blocks from the excitement of Broadway—everything Nashville has to offer is right at your doorstep!

The space
1 queen size bed, 1 sofa bed, and 1 folding twin size bed.

STR Permit#2018071745

Guest access
Parking available upon request for a fee.

Guests will be able to access the whole apartment including all of the communal areas (lounges, library, gym, pool, courtyard, grills, etc.). The assigned parking garage spot can be used for a nightly fee (1 car guaranteed). Extra vehicles can park in guest metered parking or other local lots.

Apartment #437

You will receive an email from us for 'DOOR' prior to your stay.

It will prompt you to download the app and register in order to receive access to all door codes. If you have an issue with the setting of the password, just let us know and we will resend to an alternative email. 

In order to unlock each door you will hold your phone with the 'DOOR' app open and allow it to read the code. It will unlock once the dots light up. To lock the door, you will simply touch the middle of the black screen.

Your access starts at 4:00pm check-in time until 10:00am check-out time.

Early check-in is available upon request, but not guaranteed. Our cleaners will do everything they can to have the unit ready by your early check-in request, but due to potential unforeseen circumstances that may arise, we cannot guarantee your requested time. We must first confirm the unit is ready and available before we can provide early access. There is a $25/hour charge if check-in is needed before 4pm.

Other things to note
PARKING LOT:

•Parking in Nashville can be very difficult and expensive. Upon request, we can reserve a space within our resident garage for $35/night. Please message the host to reserve the parking space, and the fee will be added to the reservation.

•If parking pass and garage opener are not returned, you will be fined $200, for each lost item.
